text:
alex: Morning handoff — I'm on until 08:00PT. Quick summary:
- What changed: prod model 3.1.2 rolled at 03:20 (deploy-bot reported success). Config tweak: batch_size=64 on the gen-api nodes.
- What to watch: p90 latency on gen-api (watch for >300ms), KV cache miss rate, and disk util on node-gpu-7 (spiked last night).
Action items:
- maria: follow up with infra on node-gpu-7 eviction logs (I dropped notes in #eng-infra).
- jin: confirm canary traffic for model 3.1.2 stays at 10% and surface any error spikes.
- anya: you're up after me — see restart instruction below if IO errors pop up.

maria: saw two small spikes ~03:40 tied to cache TTL reset. I opened a PR with a TTL diff and a small revert plan: <https://git.internal/repo/pull/482>.

jin: can confirm canary at 10%, no error-rate increase right now, but p50 jumped ~20ms after deploy. Keeping an eye on traces.

anya: noted — I can take the restart if needed. Restart command is `sudo systemctl restart infer-worker` on the node, then check `journalctl -u infer-worker -n 200`.

deploy-bot: prod deploy 3.1.2 -> success (commit abc123) :party:

devops-bot: maintenance window scheduled 2026-03-16 02:00-02:30 UTC for storage upgrades. Expect brief reconnects for batch jobs.

alex: extra context: we ran a synthetic validation at 05:00 to exercise the quantized path; it produced a few 502s on worker-gpu-2 during warmup but recovered. Relevant log sample below:
```
[2026-03-15T03:12:02Z] slow_evict: cache eviction took 1.2s (threshold 0.8s)
[2026-03-15T05:00:11Z] proxy: upstream 10.2.3.7 returned 502 during model-init
```
I'll be checking latency and traces hourly. Dashboards to monitor: /dashboards/oncall/latency, /dashboards/cache/miss-rate, /dashboards/nodes/gpu-util.

maria: I bumped the KV cache alert to trigger on 10% sustained over 5m to reduce noise; left original note in the alert runbook.

alex: leaving handoff notes in the oncall doc and pinned thread. Pager rules unchanged: gen-api high-latency -> page. If you see repeated evictions or >3 502s in 10min, escalate to infra oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:
